title: Tom Cruise and 'Digger' Divide Critics, Fueling Award Season Anticipation
seoTitle: Tom Cruise's 'Digger' Divides Critics, Fuels Oscar Buzz
subtitle: The 64-year-old actor returns to Alejandro González Iñárritu's auteur drama, seeking the long-awaited Oscar
excerpt: The trailer for “Digger,” Tom Cruise's new film directed by Alejandro González Iñárritu, has generated polarized reactions.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The release of the trailer for “Digger,” Alejandro González Iñárritu's new drama starring Tom Cruise, has sparked intense discussions among critics. The divided reaction fuels anticipation that the film could be decisive in the actor's Oscar campaign.

What is “Digger” and Why is it Controversial?

“Digger” features Cruise as Digger Rockwell, a magnate attempting to contain an environmental catastrophe caused by an oil well. The plot blends absurdity and a critique of power, and, according to the press, was designed to divide public opinion.

Critical Divide and Award Expectations

Early critics who saw the film reported extreme responses: some praise Cruise's performance and the narrative risk, while others point out flaws in its execution. This polarization, according to reports, was intentional on Iñárritu's part, who requested the press maintain secrecy regarding the film's surprises.

Tom Cruise's Oscar Campaign

With “Digger,” Cruise seeks his fourth Oscar nomination, following “Born on the Fourth of July” (1989), “Jerry Maguire” (1996), and “Magnolia” (1999). The actor, who has already received an honorary Oscar, hopes the film's “all-in” performance will convince voters.

Participation of Other Actors and Technical Crew

In addition to Cruise, the cast includes John Goodman, Riz Ahmed, Michael Stuhlbarg, and Sandra Hüller. Emmanuel “Chivo” Lubezki's cinematography and the production design are cited as strong contenders for technical categories.

Impact on the Brazilian Audience

The debate surrounding “Digger” has captured the attention of the Brazilian audience, who are following both the star's career and discussions about the relevance of a major studio film in the awards landscape. The expectation is that box office reaction and word-of-mouth will influence the Academy's perception.

With information from Variety, The Independent.
